items.headline: Albemarle Stock Slides 28% in 3 Months: Should You Buy the Dip?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 27.7% in the past three months, underperforming the Zacks Chemical - Diversified industry decline of 8.3% and the S&P 500's 3.2% increase. Falling lithium market prices have been weighing on ALB stock.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. Albemarle continues to execute on cost efficiencies and capital discipline, supporting strong free cash flow potential.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation - Albemarle Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
items.snippet: 2026 Outlook Considerations: Sales volumes are expected to be in the range of 225 to 235 kilotons lithium carbonate equivalent, as increased Wodgina volumes partially offset a delay in the Talison CGP3 ramp due to a fire that occurred on June 9.
